changes_made: Section 'Baseline, current plan, forecast and target': replaced unsupported 'the most common reason baseline reports mislead' with 'Baseline reports often mislead because these four terms are confused'.
Section 'How reserves relate to the cost baseline': replaced unsupported 'where most cost baseline errors creep in' with 'a frequent source of cost baseline errors'.

Worked example step 1: corrected the claim that management reserve exists to cover the worst case of an identified risk (contradicts the PMI Lexicon); now explains EMV's limit with the £50k vs £30k figure, mentions higher-confidence (e.g. Monte Carlo) sizing, and states MR is for unforeseen work.
BEI formula: added that the numerator counts all completed baseline tasks including early finishes beyond the status date (per DoD definition).
BEI example: removed the ambiguous 'one of them finished ahead of its baseline date' and stated that no later-baselined task finished early, so 21/24 and 'three overdue tasks' are consistent.
Quiet re-baseline: defined the reset precisely (PV = EV = AC = £121k) so the zero variances and 1.00 indices follow.
Baseline log: CR-07 £24k phasing changed from 'April to June' to 'April to July' to match the new 9 July go-live.
Baseline log: contingency drawdown now states that part of the data quality risk occurred and cost £10k, removing the inconsistency with the risk's £40k impact.

Tools section: 'Basecamp, Trello and Notion do not offer baselines' qualified as 'natively' (review pages note third-party Gantt add-ons) and added Jira's lack of built-in baseline tracking, per the Jira review page.
